text:
devops-jordan: Heads up — quick hotfix ready for rollout to unstick EU canary routing. Root cause: transient route table race after autoscaler update. Impact: some canaries in eu-west1 never received traffic, causing weird imbalance. Patch is a tiny routing-change and image bump. Risk: low, touches proxy routing only. Wants expedited approval for 5% canary for 15m then promote. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4821 :eyes:

sre-oncall: pinging oncall - do we have rollback plan?

release-bot: /deploy start image=infra/proxy:2026.03.21-hotfix canary=5m=15 region=eu-west1 trigger=manual

lena: I reviewed the diff. Looks safe. Test stubs updated, no schema changes. smoke steps in PR.

paul: +1 from infra. Rollback is re-deploy previous image and flip route flag. I can be standby for rollback.

qa-elise: ran local smoke, exercised routing path, saw expected behavior. will run quick prod smoke at canary start.

devops-jordan: Risk notes: metric to watch - proxy.route_success_rate.euw, lat_p50/95. If p95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m, abort.

sre-oncall: Agree. Also watch consumer-side 429 spikes. If that happens we abort.

lena: Approving expedited canary. @sre-oncall you OK with 5% for 15m?

sre-oncall: OK. sgo for expedited. @paul pls stand by for rollback. :thumbsup:

paul: standing by. will watch ops channel.

devops-jordan: Starting deploy in 30s. Notifying routing owners.

release-bot: Deploy started by devops-jordan - canary 5% eu-west1 - id=deploy-6133333333-A

release-bot: Canary health: 30s - route_success_rate.euw = 99.96% p95=120ms - OK

qa-elise: quick prod smoke executed: login flow, search, embed requests — all green on sampled canary hosts.

release-bot: Canary health: 7m - error_rate=0.02% p95=140ms - within thresholds.

sre-oncall: Looks stable. no 429s. greenlight for promote if no regressions in remaining window.

lena: +1 promote.

paul: +1 promote from infra.

devops-jordan: Promoting to 100% now.

release-bot: Promotion started - rolling out to remaining nodes region=eu-west1 -> id=deploy-6133333333-B

release-bot: Promotion progress: 60% -> 100% complete.

release-bot: Deploy complete. All EU proxies running image infra/proxy:2026.03.21-hotfix.

devops-jordan: Post-deploy checks: route_success_rate.euw steady, no latency regressions, traffic balanced. Closing expedited window. Thanks all. :tada:

paul: documenting in release notes and tagging the rollback playbook entry.

lena: adding brief note to changelog: "fix: routing race causing stuck canaries in eu-west1"

qa-elise: will follow up with full regression run later today.

sre-oncall: closing monitoring incident, marking as resolved unless anyone sees issues in next 30m.

devops-jordan: filed postmortem stub: https://docs.company/pm/4821-hotfix-unstick-canary — will fill details later.

release-bot: This thread closed by deploybot.
